app.name.comment: The product name, as it appears in the launcher.

batch.open_all.comment: Button on the batch notification. Opens every tab in the batch at once.

batch.summary_partial.comment: Shown while a batch is still arriving across polls, so "Open all" being short of the full batch isn't a surprise.
batch.summary_partial.message: {arrived, number} of {total, number} tabs arrived so far

batch.summary_title.comment: Batch notification title when the sender device is not known.
batch.summary_title.message: {count, plural, one {# tab received} other {# tabs received}}

batch.summary_title_from.comment: Multi-tab batch summary. The "from" variant is used when the sender device is known; the plain one covers an unnamed sender.
batch.summary_title_from.message: {count, plural, one {# tab from {senderDevice}} other {# tabs from {senderDevice}}}

channel.links_desc.comment: Android notification channel description, shown under the name in system settings.

channel.links_name.comment: Android notification channel name, shown in system settings.

relay.move_done.comment: Relay The address the user typed, echoed back after a successful move.

relay.sync_progress.comment: Progress line during a relay move. The percent sign is literal.

relay.waiting.comment: A string with an apostrophe directly before a placeholder. In ICU this is the classic trap: unescaped, it swallows the argument entirely.
